Apply camtrapDP Schemas to Data

Source: R/apply_schema_types.R
apply_schema_types.Rd

This function applies the camtrapDP schema to a frictionless data package by converting column types according to the schema definition. It includes flexible datetime parsing to accommodate multiple common formats.

Usage

apply_schema_types(data, schema, timezone = "UTC")

Arguments

data

A dataframe representing a resource (e.g., observations, deployments).

schema

A list representing the schema that defines the expected column types and constraints for the dataset.

timezone

A character string specifying the timezone for datetime conversions. Defaults to "UTC". This parameter is particularly important for camtrap data to ensure temporal alignment across deployments.

Value

A dataframe with columns transformed according to the schema.

Details

The function converts columns based on the type field in the schema:

  • "datetime": Attempts to parse using multiple common formats and maintains as POSIXct with specified timezone.

  • "date": Converts to Date class.

  • "integer": Converts to integer.

  • "number": Converts to numeric.

  • "boolean": Converts logical-like strings (e.g., 'TRUE', 'FALSE', 'T', 'F') to logical.

  • "string": Converts to character, optionally factoring if an enum constraint is present.

  • "factor": Converts to factor.

  • "any": Left unchanged, since Frictionless allows any type (e.g. Camtrap DP's exifData).

If an unknown field type is encountered, a warning is issued.
